_about: Corrections for the LIGHT PROXIES (docs/LIGHT_PROXY_PLAN.md): our own data, room ids and map coordinates only, nothing from the ROM.
Read by tools/patch_lights.py at build time (compiled into the game). Coordinates: map cells (16 world units each, as in the game's height map), rectangles inclusive.
Heights in world units (ground is usually 16, one height step = 16). Find cells / proposals: LANDSTALKER_LIGHTING_DBG=5 prints 'proxy: room R #n ...', =7 shows the proxies,
LANDSTALKER_LIGHTING_PROBE=x0,line,x1,frame prints the world position of picture pixels (cell = position / 16).
ops: flat [x0,y0,x1,y1]      - nothing in these cells casts or carries a shape (flower beds, signs); the game's box stays
water [x0,y0,x1,y1,h]   - these cells are a water floor at height h (river / pond the automatic rule missed)
remove [x0,y0,x1,y1]    - drop the automatic shapes whose centre lies in these cells
hip [x0,y0,x1,y1,z0,eave,ridge] - an own building shape: walls from z0 to eave, hip roof up to ridge
mesh [x0,y0,x1,y1] + "file" - a Blender shape (data/proxies/<file>.obj, game coordinates; recipe in remake/recipes/proxy_*.py) replaces the automatic shapes in these cells

bushes [x0,y0,x1,y1] (+ "h", "r", "base") - a BUSH block (the one step "forest" blocks are bush sprites): one round bush per RAISED cell (game height >= base + 8), the raised block itself casts nothing; bush top = the cell's game height (or base + h), radius r (default 6, max 8), base = most common height around the rectangle (or "base")
pines [x0,y0,x1,y1] (+ "h", "r", "base") - the same with a cone per cell (pine rows), trunk 4 high
v9 (2026-11-08, LIGHT_PROXY_PLAN 'NEXT BIG STEP'): FINE OPS in WORLD units (4 unit sub columns; x1 / y1 exclusive), indoors and outdoors:
box {"units": [x0,y0,x1,y1,h]} - indoors: these sub columns get height h for the light (raise OR lower; replaces the cell height)
prism {"poly": [[x,y],...], "top": h | "cell", "bottom": b, "floor": f} - a polygon footprint: indoors a solid shape up to top ("cell" = keep the cell heights: a cookie cutter);
with "bottom" a floating SLAB from bottom to top (air below: sails, arches, bridges, crowns; only layer A pixels sit on it, every shadow tests it);
"floor": the rest of its bounding cells gets height f (indoors). Ops run in list order; a later op's floor never overwrites an earlier op's shape.
mesh (+ "air": true) - a Blender shape whose parts floating more than 4 units above the ground become slabs; indoors a mesh replaces the cell heights (+ "floor").

mesh + "surface": true (2026-11-08, REAL 3D LIGHT SHAPES, GPU only) - a VERIFIED model (measured on the drawn picture, background test clean): the GPU light uses its real surfaces (model buffer for the view ray, shadow maps for the key light / sun); only for models precise enough for the remake, the older outdoor proxies lean on the carve and stay field shapes.
Slanted side faces of these shapes indoors get their own normal (16 directions from the shape around them). Test aids: LANDSTALKER_LT_FINE=0 (fine ops off),

LANDSTALKER_LT_IFORCE=1 (fine indoor paths without data: pictures must equal the old ones), LANDSTALKER_LIGHTING_DBG=1 prints 'fine: room R ...', LANDSTALKER_LT_DUMPFILE=prefix writes the light heights of each room.

carve {"cells": [x0,y0,x1,y1], "bg": "sea" | "layera", "floor": f} - at room load the shapes in these cells follow the DRAWN picture: every sub column is lowered until its top and its front edge land on drawn object pixels (sea = nothing drawn or a water tile), slabs keep the heights drawn in layer A, then a 3 x 3 median (LANDSTALKER_LT_CARVEMED). Outdoors every building shape / mesh is carved automatically to layer A (LANDSTALKER_LT_CARVEOUT=0 = off).
